I am an old woman with no schooling, and this small plot of fruit trees is part of what my family lives on. We have a few animals, so I will spread some cow dung and compost around the trees to help them grow, but I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer from the market. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and tend the plot when they have time, so we will manage the work within the family without paying outsiders. We have always grown these local trees, and I do not need to buy new seeds or sprays because the rain feeds them and we pull the weeds by hand.
